# Many Parties, One Majority Rule

<!-- STEP id="crowd-of-voices" -->
## Many Parties, Many Voices

In a **multi-party system**, several parties contest elections, so people can choose those they consider most suitable. Each party is guided by its own ideas, values and principles.

All of them work within the rules of the **Representation of the People Act, 1951**.

<!-- STEP id="fifty-percent-line" -->
## More Than Half the Seats

The party or **coalition**, a group of parties, with more than 50 per cent of the seats forms the government. The Lok Sabha has 543 seats, so it needs at least 272.

The largest opposing group becomes the **opposition**.

**Move the slider to 272 and a government forms.**
